response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development, particularly with Node.js, TypeScript, and D language, but his C++ experience is limited to early career roles (>10 years ago). He lacks recent hands-on C++ development, STL, multi-threading, and industrial cybersecurity experience (e.g., IEC 62443). While his architectural and problem-solving skills are strong, his resume does not align with the core C++ and security requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience with diverse languages and frameworks
Proven ability to architect and maintain scalable systems (e.g., GISCollective, re:cinq)
Experience with agile methodologies, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship practices
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was in 2015)
No evidence of experience with STL, multi-threading, or concurrent programming in C++
Lacks exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443) or secure coding practices for C++
